name: Stephane Rioux
headline: Creating Partner programs that allows creation of value for Customers, Partners, and AspenTech. Defining value-added solutions and offerings and the related go to market strategy.
about:
I am an experienced partnerships manager with a demonstrated history of working in the software industry with important industrial customers. I am skilled in management, program management, optimization of business processes, data analytics, business intelligence, and training. My greatest strength is managing the development of new program or business process included related change management, training, and IT process (especially SalesForce). 
I'm also experienced in direct partnership management, from small SIs and startups to large global SIs (Accenture, Wipro) and hyperscalers (Microsoft, AWS, GCP), and have a proven record on defining actionable business plans and tracking direct and influenced revenue. Finally, I have coached and onboarded new partner managers and helped them define their business plans.

experiences.position: Director and Global Lead – Partner Programs and Operations
experiences.description: My main goal is making partnership work!  Responsible for the definition and execution of our Delivery Service Provider (System Integrators) and Solutions Sales Provider (Channel) programs.  Working closely with our partner manager, sales, product, and customer success organizations to ensure that partners, customers, and AspenTech are getting the value and outcomes from using our software offering.  In addition, responsible for the partner operations team who handle partner contract, onboarding, commissions, partner portal, and partner enablement. Our coverage is global and across all AspenTech product units including Performance Engineering, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, Digital Grid Management, Subsurface Science and Engineering, Industrial Data Fabric, and Asset Performance Management.

Responsible for the relationship, strategy, go to market, and enablement of all partners working with the AspenTech DataWorks family of products including IP.21 and Inmation. One of the focus is on enabling our team to work with Hyperscalers, both on the technical side and co-development effort and on the co-selling messaging definition and pipeline execution.  We are also enabling our System Integrator and Channel partners with go to market support and technical enablement to increase our market share and usages in our customers base.

As a Partner Program Manager at AppDirect, was responsible for creating a new partner program for Systems Integrator.  This included defining the program, creating the operational, legal, commercial, and reporting process for the partner team.  I also worked closely with the documentation and learning team to define requirements for SI Partner enablement and support the Business Development team in recruiting and signing partners.  

We successfully launch the program in February 2021:
https://www.appdirect.com/about/press/releases/appdirect-launches-system-integrator-partner-program

As a Partner Enablement Manager, I develop and manage the Partner EcoSphere program to enable partners to do more with OSIsoft. This include Partner Accreditation, Partner Training, Partner Marketplace, Partner Go to Market and increasing of influence revenue, Assistance in developing the Partner Channels Strategy and finally assist the regional director in developing the partnering strategy in relation to the Global Partner team objectives. In addition, I'm a major stakeholder in our internal Digital Transformation project and been involve in creating and improving business process (both internal and external) to improve the relationship of partner with OSIsoft. This includes project in SalesForce and Skilljar. In addition, I'm developing reporting tools for the internal partner team to track progress of our Partners and different Partner Initiatives. Finally, I'm also working with the Product Management team to develop packaging for partners when launching new products or offering. This may include packaging to be used by Partners for development or Channels sales.

Responsible for managing the relationship with over 50 partners account, including relationship with large global System Integrators (Wipro, Infosys) and advanced analytics/big data company (SAS, Tibco, Cloudera).  Some of my goals were to increased influenced revenue from Partners, identify Partners that can be proper target for being a Channel Partner.

In addition, I was involves in guiding Partner in developing Solutions that will be complementary to the OSIsoft offering including Solutions Architecture and Go To Market.
